reuse.why: The API model calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already serves the other schedule consumers and decides missing, single and ranged amounts.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-implemented; the field is a one-line delegation.

placement.why: The new field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal, the existing internal-to-API mapping layer, with its type on APIScheduleEntity.

scope.why: Only the API model, a read-only ignore case in schedule-update so fetched schedules round-trip, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the expected-amount rule automatically flows to the API through the shared helper.
